description: Implementation of the BackoffEntry class managing exponential backoff logic for network requests, including delay calculations, request rejection timing, and discard conditions.

classes.name: BackoffEntry
classes.description: Manages exponential backoff timing for network request retries, including delay calculation, request rejection, and discard logic.

methods.name: BackoffEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing BackoffEntry with a policy and optional clock.

methods.name: InformOfRequest
methods.description: Updates backoff state based on success or failure of a request.

methods.name: ShouldRejectRequest
methods.description: Determines if requests should be rejected based on backoff timing.

methods.name: GetTimeUntilRelease
methods.description: Returns the time remaining until requests can be accepted.

methods.name: GetReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled release time for requests.

methods.name: SetCustomReleaseTime
methods.description: Sets a custom release time for backoff.

methods.name: CanDiscard
methods.description: Checks if the backoff entry can be discarded based on lifetime and failure count.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the backoff state to initial conditions.

methods.name: GetTimeTicksNow
methods.description: Returns current time in ticks, using the provided clock or system clock.

methods.name: CalculateReleaseTime
methods.description: Calculates the next release time based on failure count and policy.

methods.name: BackoffDurationToReleaseTime
methods.description: Converts a backoff duration into a release time in ticks.
